aggressor.description: The aggressor corporation or alliance that declared this war, only contains either corporation_id or alliance_id
aggressor.title: get_wars_war_id_aggressor

alliance_id.description: Alliance ID if and only if the aggressor is an alliance
alliance_id.title: get_wars_war_id_alliance_id

corporation_id.description: Corporation ID if and only if the aggressor is a corporation
corporation_id.title: get_wars_war_id_corporation_id

isk_destroyed.description: ISK value of ships the aggressor has destroyed
isk_destroyed.title: get_wars_war_id_isk_destroyed

ships_killed.description: The number of ships the aggressor has killed
ships_killed.title: get_wars_war_id_ships_killed

allies.description: allied corporations or alliances, each object contains either corporation_id or alliance_id
allies.title: get_wars_war_id_allies

alliance_id.description: Alliance ID if and only if this ally is an alliance
alliance_id.title: get_wars_war_id_ally_alliance_id

corporation_id.description: Corporation ID if and only if this ally is a corporation
corporation_id.title: get_wars_war_id_ally_corporation_id

declared.description: Time that the war was declared
declared.title: get_wars_war_id_declared

defender.description: The defending corporation or alliance that declared this war, only contains either corporation_id or alliance_id
defender.title: get_wars_war_id_defender

alliance_id.description: Alliance ID if and only if the defender is an alliance
alliance_id.title: get_wars_war_id_defender_alliance_id

corporation_id.description: Corporation ID if and only if the defender is a corporation
corporation_id.title: get_wars_war_id_defender_corporation_id

isk_destroyed.description: ISK value of ships the defender has killed
isk_destroyed.title: get_wars_war_id_defender_isk_destroyed

ships_killed.description: The number of ships the defender has killed
ships_killed.title: get_wars_war_id_defender_ships_killed

finished.description: Time the war ended and shooting was no longer allowed
finished.title: get_wars_war_id_finished

mutual.description: Was the war declared mutual by both parties
mutual.title: get_wars_war_id_mutual

open_for_allies.description: Is the war currently open for allies or not
open_for_allies.title: get_wars_war_id_open_for_allies

retracted.description: Time the war was retracted but both sides could still shoot each other
retracted.title: get_wars_war_id_retracted

started.description: Time when the war started and both sides could shoot each other
started.title: get_wars_war_id_started
